definitions.gloss: opening (of a curtain); start of a performance
definitions.explanation: the beginning of a theatrical performance or show when the curtain opens
the beginning of a sports season, festival, or major event

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{開幕|かいまく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: I'm going to watch the opening game.

examples.japanese: ⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧{開幕|かいまく}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧あと⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧だ。
examples.english: There's one week until the season opens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開幕|かいまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: To wait for the curtain to open.

examples.japanese: {開幕|かいまく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
⟦{劇場|げきじょう}→劇場：02714_gekijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開幕|かいまく}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦{七時|しちじ}→七時：10114_shichiji⟧です。
examples.english: The curtain time at the theater is 7 PM.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{開幕|かいまく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The film festival opened with much fanfare.

examples.japanese: {開幕|かいまく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{三連勝|さんれんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: They started the season with three consecutive wins.

notes:
{開幕|かいまく} literally means 'opening the curtain' ({開|かい} open + ⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧ curtain). Originally a theater term, it now commonly refers to the start of sports seasons and major events.

USAGE:
Used as a suru-verb: {開幕|かいまく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to open, to begin). The subject is typically an event or season, not a person.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開幕|かいまく}{戦|せん} (opening game)
- {開幕|かいまく}⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧ (opening day pitcher)
- ⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧{開幕|かいまく} (season opener)
- {開幕|かいまく}ダッシュ (strong start to a season)
- {開幕|かいまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to mark the opening)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{閉幕|へいまく}→閉幕：08175_heimaku⟧: closing (opposite)
- ⟦{開会|かいかい}→開会：04118_kaikai⟧: opening of a meeting or ceremony (more formal, official)
- ⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧: start, beginning (general-purpose)
